Maria (Marketing): FYI — I'm seeing reports of increased latency in eu-west affecting generation endpoints. Need quick statuspage copy + timing. @Li (Eng) any ETA?
Li (Eng): Investigating. Queue depth spike on model-serving pool; rolling a constrained restart to drain bad nodes. ETA ~30m to stable, will update if shorter.
Maria (Marketing): Ok. Can we do a phased comms approach? initial public: 'Investigating', targeted email to high-touch customers now, broader email only if degradation persists.
Henry (Sales): +1 on segmented emails. Please flag customers on Dedicated/Private who have SLA clauses — they need an immediate direct note from CSMs. I can pull list if ops tags them.
Sabrina (Product): Agree with phased. Draft suggestion:
- Public status (now): "We are investigating elevated latency impacting inference in eu-west. Our engineers are working on a fix and we will post updates within 30 minutes."
- Follow-up (if ongoing >15m): "Partial service degradation: some requests may see increased latency or errors. We have a mitigation in progress and an ETA for recovery."
- High-touch email subject: "Redwood Inference — service impact in eu-west (we're on it)" copy: short summary, affected products, expected scope, CSM contact, link to status page.
Li (Eng): That wording is good. One note: if we flip to 'Partial service degradation' we should call out affected API surfaces: text-gen and streaming only. Embeddings likely unaffected.
Maria (Marketing): Thanks. Plan I propose: publish 'Investigating' now (I'll post), send high-touch email in 10m with CSM/AE tags, public follow-up at 30m or sooner if resolved. If we need 'Partial degradation' copy, I'll use Sabrina's copy with Li's API note.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-003 created by Li (Eng) — Status: Investigating — Endpoint: eu-west generation. Updates will be posted to https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-003
Henry (Sales): I'll coordinate AEs to be on standby and will draft the quick email template for CSMs. Ping me when the customer list is ready.
Maria (Marketing): Cool. I'll post the statuspage update now and put the high-touch email draft in #ops-marketing-docs. :white_check_mark:
Li (Eng): Update: restart completed on a subset, latency improving but still above baseline. If trend continues it'll be stable in ~12-18m. Will post final when metrics back to normal.
Maria (Marketing): Great — hold on public follow-up until you confirm normal metrics. If we need to escalate wording, we'll switch to 'Partial service degradation' and include the API-specific note.
Henry (Sales): Thanks team. Keep me looped for any VIP outreach.
